components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button with purple gradient and persistent glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9333ea 0%, #7c3aed 50%, #6d28d9 100%); color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; font-family: 'Geist Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.25s ease, filter 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.01); filter: brightness(1.08); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.99); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action button with slate background.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #334155; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; font-family: 'Geist Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #475569; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Interactive Card
components.description: Standard card with hover lift and purple glow.
components.html:
Purchase anything

From niche websites to major Indian stores, we buy and forward it for you.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid #1e293b; background: #0f172a; padding: 1.5rem; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -12px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #a855f7 35%, #1e293b); } .ds-card-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15); color: #c084fc; margin-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #f1f5f9; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #94a3b8; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input with purple focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #1e293b; background: #0f172a; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; color: #f1f5f9; font-size: 1rem; font-family: 'Geist Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #475569; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #a855f7 55%, #1e293b); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill-shaped status indicator with semantic colors.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Geist Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-badge-success { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); color: #34d399; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); } .ds-badge-warning { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1); color: #fbbf24; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); } .ds-badge-error { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1); color: #f87171; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); } .ds-badge-info { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); color: #60a5fa; border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); }

narrative.overview: ShipIN's visual language balances professional reliability with playful energy. The system is built on a dark-first foundation (#020617) with vibrant purple gradients (#9333ea → #7c3aed → #6d28d9) that guide the eye and signal action. Glassmorphism surfaces, hover lifts, and generous purple glows create a sense of dimensionality without abandoning clarity. Motion is purposeful and bouncy—elements respond with scale transforms, vertical lifts, and smooth cubic-bezier easing (0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)—giving the interface a lively, responsive personality that makes complex international logistics feel approachable. The 3D Spline hero anchors the landing experience in spatial depth, while the rest of the platform remains scannable and functional for operation-focused workflows. This is a service interface with personality: confident in its purple voice, generous with feedback, and always dark-first.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first aesthetic with vibrant purple accent gradients
Glassmorphism and backdrop blur for layered transparency
Playful hover interactions with lift, scale, and glow
Geist Sans for clean, technical legibility
3D spatial hero contrasts with flat operational surfaces

rules.name: The Purple Voice Rule
rules.body: Purple is used for primary actions, focus states, and brand moments only. Status badges use semantic hues (blue, amber, emerald, red). Purple is the call to action, not the decoration.

rules.name: The Dark-First Rule
rules.body: All surfaces are designed for dark mode first. Light mode exists but is not the design priority; dark variants define the aesthetic.

rules.name: The Scale Step Rule
rules.body: Font sizes follow a clear scale: 0.6875rem (label) → 1rem (body) → 1.125rem (title) → 1.875rem+ (headline/display). No arbitrary in-between sizes.

rules.name: The Hover Lift Rule
rules.body: Interactive surfaces (cards, buttons) translate upward on hover: translateY(-1px) for buttons, translateY(-2px) for cards. Elevation is motion, not just shadow.

rules.name: The Glow Authority Rule
rules.body: Purple glows signal interactivity. Static informational cards use strokes; actionable surfaces get glows.

dos: Do use the primary purple gradient for CTAs and brand moments. It's the strongest voice.
Do lift interactive surfaces on hover (translateY(-1px) for buttons, -2px for cards) to signal affordance.
Do apply purple glows to actionable elements. Shadows mean interactivity.
Do use 0.75rem to 1rem radius on UI components. Consistency in curves creates rhythm.
Do design for dark mode first. Light mode is a secondary variant.
Do use the cubic-bezier easing (0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for all hover and focus transitions. Smooth, natural motion.
Do use Geist Sans for all text. Geist Mono only for tracking IDs and technical codes.
Do apply backdrop-filter blur (16px) to glassmorphism overlays. Depth through transparency.
donts: Don't use purple for status indicators. Status badges are semantic (blue, amber, red, green).
Don't apply shadows to static informational cards. Elevation signals interaction.
Don't mix border radius values arbitrarily. Stick to 0.5rem, 0.75rem, 1rem, 1.5rem scale.
Don't use light mode as the design reference. It's an inversion, not the foundation.
Don't add motion without purpose. Hover and focus get feedback; everything else stays still.
Don't forget the 8px spacing rhythm. Use 0.5rem, 0.75rem, 1rem, 1.5rem, 2rem for vertical and horizontal gaps.
Don't use generic sans-serif fallbacks before system-ui. Geist Sans → system-ui → sans-serif.
